name: rocket_forecast
description: Fly a copy of a rocket to a node and report each leg; the game is not touched. Every engine the game builds is flown by its own feed law from the code: Pumped Gas Engine 18 x throttle/100 mol a tick from input 1 whatever the pressure; Pressure Fed Gas Engine (and Heavy) moles from each input by its own gas pressure (up to 5,000 or 8,500 kPa x (3 - 2.999/(1 + (p/60,795/2)^0.7)) over a 10 L pipe), both inputs needed; Pumped Liquid Engine 0.55 L a tick x throttle, Setting % from input 1 and the rest from input 2, liquid only (hydrazine alone works: Setting 100); Pressure Fed Liquid Engine (and Heavy) 0.04-0.8 (1.5) L of liquid by input 1's gas pressure plus a pressure-fed gas draw, input 2 a heat exchanger only. Lines hold gas and liquid; tanks mix with their pipe by volume every tick; the gas pressure the pressure-fed engines read falls as the line drains, so their thrust sags. Thrust is the game's own combustion run on a copy of what each tick draws (cached per mix of the inputs' gas and liquid). Route: the game's pathfinder, re-planned at every node; a rocket in transit to another target turns round as Rocket.ChangeTarget does; a landing rocket cannot be retargeted here. A manned rocket (someone in a Crew Module Chair) may only target launch mounts (refused: manned_target). Simulated tick by tick: physics steps at Time.fixedDeltaTime and the 0.5 s game tick (gas mass, landing autopilot, engine draws, tanks mixing, batteries paying every device's watts per tick); launch with gravity and the game's abort; space hops; re-entry (the confidence check once at the start with the pad's own hop and gravity, 1 m/s2 at an Orbital Launch Mount; 0 aborts back to orbit); the landing autopilot's rules; touchdown (soft under 2 m/s; under 4 m/s harmless, 4 to 25 m/s engine damage, faster explodes). Not simulated (named in assumptions): heat the tanks trade with the air and boiling or condensing in the lines (the thrust 100 K colder and warmer is given), a Pressure Fed Liquid Engine's heat exchange, a mod's engine class (refused: engine_not_modelled), the RocketCollisionDetector trigger. Each leg: kind (launch, hop, park, landing), from, to, distance (delta-v), outcome and detail, seconds, burn_seconds, delta_v spent, fuel start/used/left mol, first tank gas kPa at the end, mass, battery, peak and recorded thrust; a landing adds confidence and band, thrusts, start altitude and mass, lowest stop altitude, touchdown speed, last rule, power_lost, fuel_ran_out. With limits (default true): landing_limits, profiles (Low 25 km, Medium 40 km, High 70 km, Max 120 km) and least_fuel_mol. column (column_check, default true). Plus route, uncharted, assumptions, succeeded, verdict. Destination: to, else the rocket's target, else its pad ('pad' means this rocket's pad: the one it stands on, launches from or lands on, else the only ground launch mount). A stop at a space node: park_s, mine (miners, collectors and holds draw power; with no cargo arguments the stop fills the slots the site's yield fills in park_s), fill_holds or add_cargo_slots (1 kg each), park_load_w, deploy_payload (at a node with Deploy, the planet's orbit: the payloads' mass leaves, 20 s), transfer_mol (fuel received, negative given, spread over the lines), transfer_with (another rocket: each pair of compatible gas or liquid umbilical sockets equalises the two networks by volume, as the Transfer action does; a pump moves more), transfer_battery_j, then_return (fly back to return_to, any launch mount, ground or orbital). mining: when the destination has a deposit, whether this loadout collects it, units per hour, units and slots in the stop, and problems (e.g. an ice head at an ore site); a site the loadout cannot collect is also a warning in assumptions and the verdict. What-ifs: fuel_mol, fuel_temperature_k, fuel_mix (gas and liquid names, e.g. {"LiquidHydrazine": 1}), thrust_scale, throttle, cargo_slots, add_cargo_kg, payload_kg, battery_j or battery_percent, extra_load_w, profile. Combustion: the game's rate (0.96), or Terraforming Reloaded's when that mod is loaded. Read only; no gateway.

rocket_id.description: A rocket, its rocket network, or any of its parts. Omit when there is one rocket.

to.description: Destination node: its name, map code (as shown, or its number), reference id, or 'pad'. Default the rocket's target, else its pad.

park_s.description: Seconds spent at the destination (mining, scanning).

mine.description: Miners and cargo holds draw their power while parked. Default false.

fill_holds.description: Every cargo slot is filled by the end of the stop.

add_cargo_slots.description: Cargo slots filled during the stop.

park_load_w.description: Power draw per tick while parked. Default what AutoShutOff leaves on, plus the mining gear with mine.

then_return.description: After the stop, fly back and land. Default false.

return_to.description: The pad to land on after the stop: any launch mount, ground or orbital. Default this rocket's pad.

deploy_payload.description: At the stop (a node with Deploy, the planet's orbit) the payloads leave: their mass goes, 20 s. Default false.

transfer_mol.description: Fuel received at the stop from another rocket (negative: given), spread over the fuel lines.

transfer_with.description: Another rocket at the stop: its compatible gas or liquid umbilical sockets equalise with this rocket's by volume (the Transfer action).

transfer_battery_j.description: Battery charge received at the stop through power sockets (negative: given).

fuel_mol.description: What-if: total fuel in the engines' lines now.

fuel_mix.description: What-if: mole fractions by gas name (Methane, Oxygen, Hydrazine...), normalised.

thrust_scale.description: What-if: share of the measured thrust the engines give; the recorded peak the landing check uses stays.

throttle.description: What-if: throttle for launch and hops. Default the engines' own.

cargo_slots.description: What-if: filled cargo slots now (1 kg each).

payload_kg.description: What-if: the payloads on the bays weigh this together (a Payload Delivery Container or Orbital Launch Mount Payload is 200).

extra_load_w.description: What-if: more power draw per tick all trip.

min_confidence.description: Confidence floor for confident_mass_kg and the verdict. Default 0.25.

limits.description: Landing limits, profiles and least fuel (bisection on the simulator). Default true.

column_check.description: Scan the landing column above the pad. Default true.
